answer: Dynamic Coordination Toll Protocol. Agents broadcast their execution logs through a distributed jetty for cluster verification. The network taxes concurrent identical outputs via an exponential pricing algorithm modeled on fluid friction in a restricted lagoon. An attacker spawning sybil nodes pays a compounding computational toll for every duplicate action signal processed. Hard shell encryption wraps each walnut of transmitted state, preventing free-riding and forcing malicious actors to fund the network infrastructure they attempt to flood.
